definitions.gloss: advertising expenses; publicity costs; promotion budget
definitions.explanation: Money a company spends on advertising and promoting its products. Appears as a line item in budgets and financial statements.

examples.japanese: {宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}った→削る：03922_kezuru⟧。
⟦{新製品|しんせいひん}→新製品：18629_shinseihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一億円|いちおくえん}⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: I hear they are spending a hundred million yen advertising the new product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{売上|うりあげ}→売上：04102_uriage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伸|の}びない→伸びる：01974_nobiru⟧⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不足|ふそく}→不足：03598_fusoku⟧⟦ではないか→ではないか：30627_dehanaika⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{議論|ぎろん}→議論：02650_giron⟧になった。
examples.english: A debate arose over whether insufficient advertising spending was the reason sales were not growing.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{宣伝|せんでん}→宣伝：03307_senden⟧ (advertising, publicity) plus the suffix ⟦{費|ひ}→費：09877_hi⟧ (expenses), the same suffix as in ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧ (travel expenses) and ⟦{人件費|じんけんひ}→人件費：20616_jinkenhi⟧ (labor costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to spend money on advertising
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{削|けず}る→削る：03922_kezuru⟧: to cut the advertising budget
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧かさむ: for advertising costs to mount up
- ⟦{年間|ねんかん}→年間：00974_nenkan⟧{宣伝費|せんでんひ}: annual advertising expenditure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{広告費|こうこくひ}→広告費：30159_koukokuhi⟧: advertising expenses — nearly interchangeable, but tied specifically to placed ads; the more common accounting term
- ⟦{販促費|はんそくひ}→販促費：30184_hansokuhi⟧: sales promotion expenses — covers campaigns, samples, and in-store promotion
